_comment: Fictional persona for SOH-221 stress data. No real people.
name: Marco Bellini
about_me: I'm Marco, chef and owner of Olive & Ash on Main Street in Ann Arbor. We're full most nights and I want to open a second location in Detroit. I'm looking for a restaurant lender or investor and for simple inventory software that my cooks will actually use.
goals: Open a second Olive & Ash location in Detroit

debriefs.text: Had a drink with Tomasz Nowak, chef-owner of Kestrel in Kerrytown. He's been looking for inventory software for a year and hates every tool. He knows Beatriz Souza, who used to run his wine program.
Met Ravi Menon at a charity dinner we catered. He's an angel who sold a logistics software company, mostly invests in healthtech, but said he likes restaurants with real numbers.
Isaac Feld from A2 Launchpad came in for lunch. He runs programs at the incubator and said they sometimes host food founders. He offered to connect me with a small-business lender.
Talked to Irene Kovacs, program manager at Detroit's Office of Mobility Innovation, at a Corktown event. She mentioned the city is courting restaurants for a new Michigan Avenue corridor.

card.headline: Chef-owner, Olive & Ash
card.about: Mediterranean restaurant on Main Street, opening a Detroit location.

request.need: A lender or investor who finances second restaurant locations
request.about_line: Ann Arbor chef-owner with a full dining room planning a Detroit location
